steps.text: Preheat oven to 400 degrees F (205 degrees C).
In a large bowl, combine the sugar, flour, cinnamon and salt. Add the beaten egg, butter, and vanilla. Mix well and add the milk.
Pour mixture into an unbaked 10 inch pie crust (glass pie plate is best).
Bake at 400 degrees for 15 minutes, then reduce heat to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C) and bake for an additional 45 minutes. Let cool and serve. Refrigerate any leftovers.

raw_recipe.headline: Cinnamon Pie
raw_recipe.description: This recipe was from our great-grandmother. Always a family favorite and a holiday must. Thin but flavorful.

review.reviewBody: I did a search for Cinnamon Pie after watching the Dual Spires episode of Psych... This is the only recipe that even popped up under allrecipes for a cinnamon Pie. This recipe Extremely Easy to make... like extremely easy... which is a good thing for me. A lot of times recipes like this are way too complicated... This took about 15 minutes to prepare with the kids getting in the way and 45 min to bake and about an hour to cool at room tempature. Mine didn't really look like the picture though.. I know some people said it looks 'ugly' beucase of the color, yes, it is ugly, but to me it looks like a pumpkin pie just a little on the darker side. If you like cinnamon you will like this... and if you are not a HUGE cinnamon fan.. I still think you might like it.. I am not huge on cinnamon, but I will definately make this again.

This recipe is good and turned out great but based on other reviews, I did make some changes. I used a 9 in. frozen pie crust, 1/2 cup liquid egg substitute, 3/4 cup sugar, 2 tsp. cinnamon, and 1 cup milk. If you love cinnamon, 1 tsp. will not be enough. Using less milk makes it not as runny and the extra egg makes it a little thicker. In my opinion, it was too sweet even with less sugar and next time I will use 1/2 cup sugar instead. I will also decrease the amount of butter by half as well. The frozen premade pie crust I used did fine and was not too soggy. I used the directions for baking it and it was jiggly when I got it out but it firmed up soon after. It's a thin pie but still delicious.

I was so excited about finding this pie, but after reading the reviews I got a little worried about the texture of the pie, so I made a few adjustments: I added an egg and an extra teaspoon of cinnamon, I subbed the milk in recipe for a 12oz can evaporated milk, and for a little something extra I sprinkled some Hershey's cinnamon chips on the bottom before I ladeled in the filling. The pie was absolutely delicious!! It had the perfect custard texture that I was hoping for.

I've made this awesome pie a few times..this recipe is a keeper! Last time, I changed it up by adding thinly sliced apples first then pouring the cinnamon(1/2 c less milk)mixture over.The family loved it even more.

This was amazing! We got the idea from Psych and had to try it. I used heavy cream instead of milk and 2tsp. of cinnamon. I also pre baked the pie crust. It wasn't ugly either. I served it with some cool whip too. I plan to take it to my next event!

Whoever wrote this recipe did a heinous job.

It is never stated that this is a custard. Would have made a world of difference.
You do NOT mix everything together at the same time. Mixture can easily be over mixed causing it to separate. Butter needs to be cooled completely or it’ll start cooking the eggs and the eggs need to be mixed in last and slowly to prevent curdling.

I made this recipe twice now exactly as it’s written and it came out as disgusting curdled soggy slop; even after baking for an extra hour. I tried it with the homemade butter crunch crust and with a premade crust. I tried blind baking the shell first and tried unbaked but neither option helped. 

This recipe needs to be rewritten. Good luck to all other chefs and bakers!

Very tasty, and very easy. I too was brought here after being Psych-inspired. This pie as great. Alterations I made were: used 1/2 cup of heavy cream in place of 1/2 cup of milk, used brown sugar instead of white, and added a tsp of cinnamon. Next time I will likely add even more cinnamon - but I am a huge cinnamon fan. Other reviewers have commented that this pie is kind of ugly, and I'll admit that it's not the most attractive dessert that I've ever made, or eaten, but the taste more than makes up for it. Overall I love this recipe!

I am not a big pie person but I too wanted to try this after Psych. This pie was good. I made this twice, once following the recipe and once with a little variation. I got to say that the original recipe was a little flavorless and a little too runny for my taste. The second time I made it I added a 1/4 cup of brown sugar, one egg, 1 1/2 of cinnamon and 1 tbls of flour. I also reduced the milk to 1 1/4 cup. This gave it a better taste and a texture similar to pumpkin pie. I did as others suggested and used the Buttery Crunch Crust recipe, and I would suggest leaving out the pecans with the original recipe because it seemed to overpower the taste of the cinnamon.

Another Psych fan— loved this!!! Just what I imagined! So easy. I used (and recommend 8 inch pie plate and extra 1/2 teaspoon of cinnamon). Seems like a weird combo of ingredients but just trust the recipe and the process. I cooked it the times said in recipe and had no idea how to judge if it was done so just took it out after that. And then as others recommended, I let it cool well before cutting into it.

I was a little worried about the pie being runny after reading other reviews, so I added one egg and put in 2 TBSP flour instead of 1 1/2 and upped the cinnamon to 2 tsp. I absolutely no problems making it. I disagree with others, I like it better cold. Last night it was good, but this morning it is amazing. If you are a custard fan you will like this pie.

It looks like I'm the only one who had this boil over in the oven. After the first 10 minutes I heard something sizzling and then smelled the burning sugar, I opened the oven door to be greeted by a cloud of smoke. I turned the heat down to 300 for the rest of the 45 minutes and that seemed to stop it from boiling over anymore.If I try this again (and that's a BIG if) I'll start it off in a 375 degree oven and go down to 300 and watch it like a hawk. And I'd put the pie plate on top of a cookie sheet just in case. The taste was only so so when I tried it but after it sat awhile the taste improved some.
I was excited to try this one…super easy!! I added a layer of Cool Whip on top after it cooled, along with an extra sprinkling of cinnamon and sugar. Family loved it!
Fantastic!!! My family loves it.
Very easy to make. It makes the house smell divine and serving w vanilla ice cream
Easy to make and tastes good. After reading other reviews I did modify the recipe to include 1 tablespoon of cinnamon, 2 eggs and I used half/half instead of milk.

didn't have the ingredients or energy to make the pie crust so I just made the custard part. Added 2 eggs, & had very little vanilla extract so I added Cherry extract it's still cooking in a loaf pan I'll let you know how it is but it smells delicious! I'm SURE it will satisfy my sweet tooth!??

As many previous posters, I came looking for a cinnamon pie recipe following the Dual Spires episode on Psych. This is a delicious and easy to make treat! I doubled the recipe to make two at once and it turned out fine. I will be making this again and again!
It’s ok. A bit soggy.
Funny, I just read that I am not the only one searching for this recipe after watching an episode of psych
Didn’t set. Not much flavor. Seems like too much milk or not enough eggs
